subject: Control mapping workshop and third-party evidence asks (SIG / ISO / SOC2)
messages:
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@cobaltsys.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@cobaltsys.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial RFP intake — control mapping workshop and evidence asks

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the quick intro call yesterday. As we evaluate Redwood for our generative search product, our security & procurement teams need a clear control mapping across SIG, SOC 2 and ISO 27001, plus a list of concrete artifacts we can expect to receive for each control.

Two asks to start the process:
- Can Redwood run a 60-minute control-mapping workshop next week with our assurance and infra leads? We prefer the week of Aug 17.
- Can you send a short evidence manifest template — we need to map artifact owners and delivery dates on our side.

We also have a few third-party vendor items (KMS/HSM and cloud infra) that will need explicit callouts in the crosswalk.

Appreciate it — Samantha
Samantha Cole
Sr. Procurement Manager, Cobalt Systems
---
Note: we'll be pulling this into our RFP tracker (ProcureID: COB-2027-49).
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@cobaltsys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial RFP intake — control mapping workshop and evidence asks

Samantha — thanks for the clear asks. We can run the workshop and will bring the product+security owners to align on mapping and artifact responsibilities.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue Aug 17, 11:00–12:00
- Wed Aug 18, 09:30–10:30

Deliverables from our side for the session:
- control mapping draft (SIG -> SOC2/ISO crosswalk)
- evidence manifest template with suggested owners and delivery windows
- list of third-party attestations and where to reference vendor artifacts (KMS, cloud infra, SIEM logs)

Karthik, Jasmine — can you prepare the draft crosswalk and a short agenda? I flagged Monica to help coordinate artifact collection after workshop.

Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft control crosswalk and artifact ask (internal)

Team — attaching my working draft and a short agenda for the workshop. Highlights:
- I mapped SIG v2026 1.0 controls to the closest SOC2 CC/ISO 27001 clauses where we have equivalent mechanisms. The sheet has three columns: control statement, redwood implementation (procedural + technical), evidence types.
- For third-party components (KMS/HSM backed keys, cloud provider managed DB), I added a vendor reference column and suggested artifact: vendor SOC2 report, configuration screenshots, and an SSO audit for access.
- Risks/uncertainties: data residency controls for EU customers (we need legal confirmation on our replication/backup policy language).

Planned attachments: redwood_ctrl_map_v1.xlsx (draft), meeting-agenda-control-workshop.pdf

Action items before workshop:
1) Monica to draft evidence_manifest_20270818.csv template for owner sign-up.
2) Jasmine to pull the latest vendor attestations we host in the compliance drive.

Karthik
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@cobaltsys.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@cobaltsys.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial RFP intake — control mapping workshop and evidence asks

Logan — Wed Aug 18 09:30 works for us. We'll include our Head of Assurance (Tom) and the infra lead.

One immediate ask: could you attach the evidence manifest template and a short list of sample artifacts we should expect to receive within a 2-week intake window post-workshop? Our internal tracker requires an ETA for each artifact.

I'll add the meeting to calendar for Wed at 09:30 PDT.

Thanks,
Samantha
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@cobaltsys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Deliverables: control mapping draft + evidence manifest (post-workshop follow-up)

Samantha / Tom — great workshop today, appreciate the focused questions from your assurance team. Attached are the items we promised:
- redwood_ctrl_map_v1.xlsx — draft crosswalk (SIG->SOC2/ISO) with inline notes on evidence location and owner at Redwood.
- evidence_manifest_20270818.csv — template for artifact owner sign-up, suggested priority (P1/P2), and target delivery dates.
- meeting-agenda-control-workshop.pdf — final agenda and decisions log.

Quick summary of agreed next steps:
1) Cobalt to assign owners in the evidence_manifest for the artifacts that require customer-provided materials (e.g., access configs, customer-side audit logs) — target Aug 25.
2) Redwood to stage vendor attestations and screenshots for KMS and cloud infra — target Aug 23.
3) Legal teams to review the data residency notes Karthik flagged; we will follow up with a one‑page summary by Aug 26.

If anything's missing in the manifest, flag it in the Google Drive link and we'll update.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
